searchText: In current version of FOCIL, we don't support blob transactions. Should we add a rule that checks if there is no blob transactions in the ILs to the P2P validation? To the CL, transaction content is just opaque bytes, it can't tell whether it is a blob tx or not But the EL can. If an IL transaction includes a type 3 tx, the EL should skip it We can amend this behavior in the execution layer spec or the EIP Let me add this to execution-api. Thanks! just flagging Vitalik's latest post as it mentions FOCIL a lot, in case you guys have thoughts https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/formalizing-decentralization-goals-in-the-context-of-larger-l1-gaslimits-and-2020s-era-tech/23942

excerpts.content: In current version of FOCIL, we don't support blob transactions. Should we add a rule that checks if there is no blob transactions in the ILs to the P2P validation?

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
To the CL, transaction content is just opaque bytes, it can't tell whether it is a blob tx or not
But the EL can. If an IL transaction includes a type 3 tx, the EL should skip it
We can amend this behavior in the execution layer spec or the EIP

excerpts.author: jih2nn
excerpts.content: Let me add this to execution-api. Thanks!
